title: Multimodal dataset from the CMx7-MM Experiment
description: A raw multimodal dataset from 30 healthy right-handed adults performing a hierarchy of cognitive, motor, and combined cognitive-motor tasks across three sessions. It includes EEG, fNIRS, ECG, EMG, Biodex torque/kinematics, push-button responses, and subjective ratings of sleepiness and cognitive load. The data are organized in BIDS and are unprocessed exports from the acquisition systems.
methods_description: Participants sat in a Biodex chair in a quiet, dimly lit room and completed seven tasks per session (mental arithmetic, auditory 2-back, motor imagery, passive motor, active motor, N-back arithmetic, and a combined full task). Each task lasted 3 minutes with 30 s rests, in random order, and auditory stimuli were delivered via MATLAB/Psychtoolbox. EEG was recorded with 32 channels (10-20 system), together with fNIRS (prefrontal and sensorimotor montages), ECG (Delsys Trigno), and Biodex torque. The Karolinska Sleepiness Scale was administered before each session and mental load ratings after each task.
